    static class Edge {
        int vertex1, vertex2, capacity, flowCost, id;

        public Edge(int vertex1, int vertex2, int capacity, int flowCost, int id) {
            this.vertex1 = vertex1;
            this.vertex2 = vertex2;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flowCost = flowCost;
            this.id = id;
        }
    }

    static class Graph {
        int numVertices, numEdges;
        int[] flowCosts;
        Edge[] edges;
        Map<Integer, Integer>[] vertexToEdgesById;

        public Graph(int numVertices, int numEdges) {
            this.numVertices = numVertices;
            this.numEdges = numEdges;
            this.flowCosts = new int[numEdges];
            this.edges = new Edge[numEdges];
            this.vertexToEdgesById = new Map[numVertices];

            for (int i = 0; i < numVertices; i++) {
                vertexToEdgesById[i] = new HashMap<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < numEdges; j++) {
                    vertexToEdgesById[i].put(j, null);
                }
            }
        }

        public void addEdge(int vertex1, int vertex2, int capacity, int flowCost, int id) {
            Edge e = new Edge(vertex1, vertex2, capacity, flowCost, id);
            edges[numEdges] = e;
            vertexToEdgesById[vertex1].put(numEdges, e);
            vertexToEdgesById[vertex2].put(numEdges, e);
            flowCosts[numEdges] = flowCost;
            numEdges++;
        }

        public Edge[] getEdges() {
            return edges;
        }
    }

    static class VertexInfo {

    static class EdgeWithPriority implements Comparable<EdgeWithPriority> {
        Edge edge;
        int priority;
        int index;

        public EdgeWithPriority(Edge edge, int priority, int index) {
            this.edge = edge;
            this.priority = priority;
            this.index = index;
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(EdgeWithPriority other) {
            return Integer.compare(this.priority, other.priority);
        }
    }
